lede: Abdul El-Sayed was the day's one true crossover: 808,705 Wikipedia views, and at the same time a live Polymarket contract on whether he wins the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination. Underneath that, Lemmy fixed on a single theme, pressure to replace Hakeem Jeffries and Chuck Schumer, with a petition to swap out Jeffries passing 500k signatures. GitHub's fastest riser was NVIDIA's auto-ontology, up 2,679 stars in a day. In the background, USGS logged 25 earthquakes, the largest a magnitude 6.1 deep beneath the Fiji region.
